'''Vale City''' was a large population center located near a river on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagro]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the city was spared from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attack due to the actions of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
